title: Jetboard on Lakes near the Mile high city.
requirements: Not recommended for travelers with poor cardiovascular health
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: Add something exciting and adventurous to your Denver experience. Book a session on our state-of-the-art electric surfboards! We supply everything you need from lessons to life jackets. Our instructors are efficient and energetic, ready to make the most out of your adventure. In our 60-minute session you start off as a beginner and work your way to the top with our expert mode reaching up to 24mph! We also offer ridding experiences on a variety of lakes throughout Colorado such as Chatfield, Pueblo, Horsetooth and many more. Let's start off this summer with a blast and a splash.
